name: vantage
description: A fast, private browser: up to four pages on one screen, built-in ad blocking and VPN, multi-connection downloads, the password vault with autofill, and your Library.
author: Bilal

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Websites you allow can use the camera, for example for video calls.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Websites you allow can use the microphone, for example for video calls.
extendInfo.NSLocationUsageDescription: Websites you allow can see your approximate location.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vantage finds Chromecasts and TVs on your network so you can cast videos.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Websites you allow can connect to Bluetooth devices.
